elements.title: 3D Scatterplot of Iris Dataset by Species

details.values: data points plotted with sepal length, sepal width, and petal length coordinates, colored by species code 0,1,2

elements.summary: This 3D scatterplot visualizes the Iris dataset, plotting sepal length, sepal width, and petal length on three axes, with points colored by species to distinguish setosa, versicolor, and virginica.
